comparison.title: One-time setup — not rented forever
comparison.subtitle: Most chatbot platforms charge you every month, forever. We build it once, on your own number — your assistant and its data are yours.

items.q: Is this the official WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: No. We connect to your own WhatsApp as a linked device — no Meta Business API approval and no per-message fees. It behaves like you, replying from your own number.

items.q: Is there a risk of my number getting banned?
items.a: We build to WhatsApp's rules: replies only (never cold spam), human-like pacing, rate limits and instant opt-out. Used as a responder rather than a bulk sender, the risk stays low.

items.q: Do I need a new WhatsApp number?
items.a: No. We set it up on a number you already use, or a fresh one if you prefer to keep it separate.
Call Rescue within 12 hours, Job Desk within 8 hours, Always-On Desk within 4–6 hours — after we have your business details.
Any language your customers write in, including English, Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese and Hinglish.

The setup is a one-time payment and it's yours to keep. To keep it hosted, monitored and improving we offer a small monthly care plan (from ₹2,000/mo) — it's optional, and you can cancel anytime without losing your setup or your leads.

items.q: Can it answer the phone, not just WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes — our Voice add-on lets the AI answer your missed calls too. It's a monthly add-on (from ₹7,999/mo) you can switch on any time after go-live.

items.q: What if it doesn't work for my business?
items.a: If it doesn't do what we agreed in the first 7 days, we'll fix it free or refund the setup. The guarantee covers our delivery — not a number of jobs or sales.
Yes. It's config-driven and tuned for home services — plumbers, electricians, AC/HVAC, cleaning, pest control, painters, carpenters, appliance repair and more.
